headline: Introduces support for round toggle switches and animated decorative ornaments in BetterBags Next themes.

entries.title: Custom switch styles for themes
entries.details: Themes can now style settings toggles as rounded switches with a sliding knob and hover glow alongside the traditional square style.

entries.title: Animated panel ornaments for themes
entries.details: Themes can now display decorative artwork and borders anchored to bag panels, complete with smooth ambient animations like swaying, bobbing, and pulsing.
